attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: website-content-ingestion-pipeline

steps:
  - id: fetch_sitemap
    op: http/get
    params:
      url: "https://www.clubwebsite.com/sitemap.xml"
      headers:
        Accept: "application/xml"
      on_error: fail
    output: sitemap_xml

  - id: parse_sitemap_urls
    op: xml/parse
    params:
      input: "{{sitemap_xml.body}}"
      xpath: "//url/loc"
    output: page_urls

  - id: split_into_batches
    op: list/chunk
    params:
      input: "{{page_urls}}"
      size: 10
    output: url_batches

  - id: process_batches
    op: loop/for_each
    params:
      items: "{{url_batches}}"
      variable: batch
      wait_between: 5000
    steps:
      - id: fetch_page_content
        op: loop/for_each
        params:
          items: "{{batch}}"
          variable: page_url
          on_error: skip
        steps:
          - id: fetch_html
            op: http/get
            params:
              url: "{{page_url}}"
              headers:
                Accept: "text/html"
              on_error: skip
            output: page_html

          - id: extract_main_content
            op: html/select
            params:
              input: "{{page_html.body}}"
              selector: ".main_content"
            output: main_content

          - id: index_to_vector_store
            op: vectorstore/upsert
            params:
              namespace: knowledge_base
              content: "{{main_content}}"
              metadata:
                source_url: "{{page_url}}"
                ingested_at: "{{now}}"
              embed: true
            output: index_result
